messages.text: Design review moved to Thursday 2 PM. Bring your latest rocket numbers.
The 3D printer in the lab is back up. New nozzle, prints are clean again.
Lunch is on the team today. Pizza at noon in the big room.
Static margin came out at 1.4 calibers on the last sim. A bit low for the windy forecast.
I can lengthen the body tube 10% tonight and rerun it.
Perfect. Also check the fin span, the new motor is heavier.
@You can you send the updated STEP file before the review?
Quadcopter props arrived. Two of them are chipped, sending them back.
Gearbox pinion is out of stock until next week. I ordered the steel one instead.
Nice work on the rocket demo yesterday.
Thanks! Albie did most of the talking.
Can you walk the new interns through the workspace tomorrow at 10?
Sending you the flight log from Saturday's test.
Got it, apogee looks right on target.

incoming.text: Wind is down to 8 mph for Saturday. Can you send me the final fin span by tonight?
